details: Brand-new radio, first connection, 1.0.69 on Windows 11: Windows could not open COM3 before any radio traffic. Likely the cable driver (TH-9800 cables are usually Prolific PL2303, refused by current Windows drivers) or a wrong/stale port. User-side; FAQ #cable-driver and #which-port.
summary: COM3 not available on first read (Windows 11)
